rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CII things considerable before judgement
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: New printed natal chapter CII lays out a prerequisite assessment before any chart judgment.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Stable sequential editorial CIII, single body page PDF558/printed524.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: having rectified your Nativity by Accidents
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: It presupposes a chart has first been corrected by significant life events.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Lilly's favored technique remains retrospective fitting, not proven birth-time accuracy.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: which alone of all other wayes is most certaine
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He calls event-rectification more certain than other methods.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Author confidence, not comparative scientific accuracy.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: take fortitudes and debilities of all Planets
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The astrologer must assess strengths and weaknesses of every planet.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical dignity scores, not physical causal power.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: and Part of Fortune
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The assessment also includes Part of Fortune.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Derived chart point with distinct location requirements.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: observe in what houses and parts of heaven
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Note each planet's house position and part of the celestial figure.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Requires verified prior house erection.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: where ... parts Zodiac strongly extend influences
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He differentiates sectors in which traditional influences are believed stronger.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No independently established influence intensity.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: operate more weakly and remissly
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Other placements are treated as weakening the alleged influence.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Another branch of the dignity/source method.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: understand strength imbecility of Significator or Promittor
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Before predicting, assess the particular significator or promissor as strong or weak.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Depends on prior flexible selection of which objects signify the event.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Life
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source lists length or conditions of life among natal judgment topics.
rules.original_source_qualifications: High-stakes longevity claim, not medical evidence.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Preferment
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Social/career advancement is an example category.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical category with no validated base rate.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Marriage
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Marriage is listed as a subject to judge.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Does not identify actual marriage outcome.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Estate
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Possessions/property are included.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No independent observed financial effects.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Travell of Native
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Travel is included among predicted life affairs.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No dated prospective travel test.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: mutuall correspondency configuration with other Planets
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Check the chosen planet's aspects/configurations with others.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Multiple competing favorable/adverse aspect interpretations.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: abilities either to effect performe what promised
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He says the planet's ability to perform its predicted effect depends on condition.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Allows conditional reinterpretation of predictions.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: nature posture in heavens his motion fortitude
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The astrologer must assess nature, location, movement and dignity.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Several separate candidate conditions, not independent cases.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: configuration good or evill Planets
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Aspects with traditionally benefic or malefic planets supposedly determine favorable or unfavorable outcomes.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Traditional assignment, no empirical validation.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: do in like nature for Part of Fortune
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Apply a similar positional analysis to Part of Fortune.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Separate from evaluating the seven planets.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Antiscions and Contrantiscions all Planets
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Calculate each planet's antiscia and contra-antiscia positions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Reflection points increase potential matching positions.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: how neere cuspes of houses
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Assess proximity of those antiscia points to house cusps.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No fixed numerical orb specified on this page.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: or degrees of any of Planets
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Also assess proximity to the zodiacal degrees of other planets.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Separate set of proximity comparisons.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: fixed Starres first or second Magnitude
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author uses stars classed in the first or second magnitude.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Only particular fixed-star subset, not all visible stars.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: small Latitude from Ecliptick
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Within that subset he emphasizes stars with small ecliptic latitude.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Threshold not numerically defined here.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: nature fixed Starres same condition Planet
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He evaluates whether such stars share the associated planet's supposed condition.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Additional discretionary analogical classification.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: add vigour to Significator point
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He claims similarly classified fixed stars add strength to the nearby significator or point.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source causal claim unverified; not an astronomical force finding.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CIII Of the space of Life
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A separate chapter begins immediately on original PDF559/printed525, concerning longevity.
rules.original_source_qualifications: It is NOT continuation of Chapter CII; high-stakes mortality assertions kept out of current body.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Native like to live long or not
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The following page asks whether the individual is likely to live a long time.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical astrology belief, not valid clinical survival prediction.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Parents Nativities and infant sickness
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Following chapter discusses parental charts, children and illness.
